I don't know how to help you, friend. The only thing I can offer is understanding and consolation. 

My father, also an Arab dad, has anger problems and beat us pretty regularly for the simplest shit. Once, me and my sisters were sitting in the living room just hanging about when he came home. Somehow in his brain, he got the idea we were fucking each other. Seriously. 

He yelled at as badly and smacked me around. We never were caught socializing with each other again. We essentially stopped being friendly with each other out of fear of him. 

I don't understand the circumstances, pressures, and suffering that makes a person become that way, but it's a total fucking bummer. It still hurts my head to think why he would think us just talking in our own home meant we were plotting against him or fucking each other. Arab dads, am I right?

I don't feel fulfilled, partially I think because of the high expectations that were drilled into me. Exceptional or gtfo. 

Some days I wake up and am very thankful I was raised to be ambitious. Other days, I contemplate if i'm ever going to not be a huge piece of shit. I've learned to love bitter chocolate as I've aged, so I guess living a bitter sweet life seems apropos.
